title: Grateful Dead Live at Dane County Coliseum on 1973-02-15
source: Recording Info: SBD MR > R (Bob Menke) > R (Pat Lee); Transfer Info: Technics 1506 w/Lamb Labs Dolby decoder > WAV (24bit/96k) > Apogee Mini Me 24/96 > Apogee Mini DAC monitoring and mastering > FLAC; Mastered By Matt Smith

ai_review.summary: Excellent soundboard capture of a 1973 gem, highlighted by a smoking Dark Star → Eyes → China Doll sequence.
ai_review.review: The reviewer rates this show among their top‑5 ever and praises the Dark Star > Eyes > China Doll suite as the perfect entry point. The recording is a soundboard (sbd) source and is described as clear with no noted flaws, making it a highly enjoyable listen.

ai_rating.rationale: Single enthusiastic review gives high marks for both performance (standout Dark Star suite) and recording clarity; limited data yields low confidence.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Reviewer notes clear, crisp audio when listening with headphones and reports no issues.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Highlights early in the concert with a seamless Dark Star/Eyes/China Doll suite; overall praised as a classic 1973 performance.
